chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibrahim ibn Uqba, from Muyassar, from Muhammad ibn Abdul Aziz, from his father, from Abu Ja'far or Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'then let him see which of them has purest food, so let him bring you provision from it'. He said: 'The purest food is dates.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'purest food' refer to in the context of the People of the Cave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi offers a specific exegetical interpretation (tafsir) of the phrase 'purest food' in Surah Al-Kahf, identifying dates as the preferred sustenance of the People of the Cave. It highlights the high status of dates in Shia tradition not only as a staple food but as a symbol of purity and divine provision, reinforcing their spiritual and physical benefits.
